abstract: In 28 cases of postmenopausal women with non-functioning ovarian tumors, the estradiol (E2) level was assayed in peripheral plasma and tumor tissue extract. E2 precursors were also assayed in the tissue extract, and localization of 3beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (3beta-HSD) in the tissue was investigated. The plasma E2 levels were 153.8 +/- 205.9 pg/ml in 15 benign tumor cases, 244.3 +/- 336.5 pg/ml in 13 malignant tumor cases, and both of which were significantly higher than 12.3 +/- 3.6 pg/ml in normal postmenopausal women (p less than 0.01). The postoperative plasma E2 level (33.3 +/- 32.7 pg/ml) was significantly lower than the preoperative one (228.3 +/- 319.0 pg/ml). Twelve of 19 cases (68.2%) showed a postoperative decline in the E2 level to less than a half of the preoperative level. E2 and its precursors were found in tumor tissue. These findings demonstrate that E2 is produced by the tumor tissue itself. In addition, 3beta-HSD activity was localized in the stroma of ovarian tumors, indicating that E2 synthesis is mainly carried out in stromal cells rather than in epithelial cells.
abstract_ja: 閉経後の無機能性卵巣腫瘍患者28例について、末梢血漿および腫瘍組織抽出液中のエストラジオール(E2)レベルを測定した。また、腫瘍組織抽出液中のE2前駆体を測定し、組織内の3β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素(3β-HSD)の局在を検討した。血漿E2レベルは良性腫瘍15例で153.8±205.9 pg/ml、悪性腫瘍13例で244.3±336.5 pg/mlであり、いずれも正常閉経後女性の12.3±3.6 pg/mlより有意に高かった(p<0.01)。術後の血漿E2レベル(33.3±32.7 pg/ml)は術前(228.3±319.0 pg/ml)より有意に低下した。19例中12例(68.2%)では、術後のE2レベルが術前の半分未満に低下した。E2およびその前駆体は腫瘍組織内に認められ、腫瘍組織自体がE2を産生することが示された。さらに、3β-HSD活性は卵巣腫瘍の間質に局在しており、E2合成は上皮細胞よりも主に間質細胞で行われていることが示唆された。
